# Fruit Slice source snapshot

This versioned snapshot contains the 418 original client files and the unchanged download manifest collected for game 235576 (切水果大师). The manifest records the source URLs, collection time, sizes and SHA-256 values. Platform SDK downloads outside `original/` are not included.

The offline adapter reads this fixed directory directly; it does not require ignored `artifacts/` downloads. `original/` is source evidence for reproducible transformation and is not the APK runtime directory. The adapted runtime is stored in `Assets/StreamingAssets/fruit-slice/`.

The recorded public source and possession of these files do not grant any additional license or redistribution rights. Original rights remain with their respective holders.
